text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: We've met at last! A hundred years from now, you'll still remember this day! Let us settle this, Shogun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここで会ったがヒャクネンメ！
決めましょう、
ショーグン！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
The technique born from the bond between Shogun and me!
Amour Ninja Art... BLAZING CRIMSON WHIRLWIND OF LOVEEE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシと
ショーグンの
絆の技──
アムール忍法・
烈火之紅恋旋風ゥ～！！
